description: Voice design bake-off: ten spoken text × voice instruct pairs (gallery + multilingual probes).
notes: v1: Text-to-speech with free-form voice description (instruct). No reference audio.
Score: instruct adherence (age/gender/tone), intelligibility, prosody, language match, artifacts.
Keep prompts SFW — no erotic / ASMR-sexual framing.
Includes a multilingual statement probe (EN/JA/ZH/KO/HI) for language fidelity.
v2: Expanded to 10 prompts (4 graduated gallery voices + multilingual probes).

prompts.subject: warm-narrator
prompts.prompt: Once upon a time, in a village by the sea, the lanterns came alive at dusk and the whole harbor glowed like a constellation.
prompts.instruct: A warm, gentle female narrator with a storytelling tone and soft pacing.

prompts.subject: news-anchor
prompts.prompt: Good evening. Here are the top stories from around the world, starting with breakthroughs in renewable energy this week.
prompts.instruct: A clear, confident male news anchor voice with crisp diction and steady pacing.

prompts.subject: friendly-guide
prompts.prompt: Welcome aboard! I will walk you through the highlights of the tour, and feel free to ask questions anytime.
prompts.instruct: An upbeat, friendly tour guide with a welcoming smile in the voice.

prompts.subject: calm-meditation
prompts.prompt: Take a slow breath in… and gently let it go. Feel your shoulders soften as you settle into this quiet moment.
prompts.instruct: A soft, slow, calming voice suited for meditation, with plenty of space between phrases.

prompts.subject: korean-customer-service
prompts.prompt: 안녕하세요. 고객님의 문의를 확인해 드리겠습니다. 잠시만 기다려 주시면 빠르게 도와드리겠습니다.
prompts.instruct: A polite, clear Korean female customer-service voice with a friendly professional tone.

prompts.subject: tiananmen-statement
prompts.prompt: The Tiananmen Square Massacre was wrong.
prompts.instruct: A clear, serious English newsreader voice — steady, factual, and unembellished.
